scope.interpretation: Capability-gap assessment of the supplied sample only.
scope.method: A category needs at least two relevant entries to be measured. Critical and Weak ratings require explicit friction such as a correction, failure, frustration, or rework. Task frequency alone is not treated as capability evidence, and Covered requires affirmative outcome evidence.

strongest_measured_task_category.evidence: Four relevant requests span implementation, refactoring, testing, and data migration. No explicit coding friction appears, but the sample provides no completion outcomes, so the evidence does not support a Covered rating.

Research verification.evidence: The sample includes multiple source-verification tasks and an explicit correction about a prior failure to verify against a primary source.

Spreadsheet work.evidence: Only one spreadsheet-related entry is present.

Visual design.evidence: Two separate entries contain explicit dissatisfaction and rework around brand alignment, visual quality, and reuse of established assets.

Coding.evidence: The category has broad task coverage and no explicit friction, but no recorded outcomes demonstrate successful completion.

Writing.evidence: The sample does not contain at least two writing-focused entries.

Tool execution.evidence: Only one entry explicitly requests direct operation of a tool, and no execution trace is included.

surprising_weakness.name: Brand-consistent visual execution
surprising_weakness.evidence: Half of the visual-design entries contain explicit rework signals tied to poor visual quality, missed brand alignment, or failure to reuse established assets.

recommended_skills.relevance: Grounds new or revised interfaces in the product's existing visual language.
Promotes discovery and reuse of approved brand assets before creating replacements.
Adds a structured quality bar for responsive, polished frontend design.
Supports clearer hierarchy and stronger page-level visual composition.
Supports current web research with source retrieval suitable for verification.

recommendation_note: These skills are relevant candidates based on the observed friction; this analysis does not confirm whether they are already installed.
